gameRecap.title: Game Recap: Cavaliers 116, Bucks 114
gameRecap.subTitle: The Cavaliers improve to 8-0 to tie their best start in franchise history as they defeated the Bucks, 116-114. Darius Garland led the way for the Cavaliers with 39 points (7-11 3pt. FG) and eight assists, while Jarrett Allen added 14 points, 15 rebounds, and six assists for the Cavaliers in the victory. Damian Lillard tallied 36 points (5-9 3pt. FG) and seven assists for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Bucks fall to 1-6 on the season.
